title: Leave a comment
instructions_md:
## Notes for people

A line that starts with `#` is a **comment**. Python skips it. People use comments to explain code.

```python
# Greet the reader.
print("Welcome!")
# print("This line does not run.")
```

```text
Welcome!
```

To stop a line of code from running, put `#` in front of it.

## Your task

The program prints three lines. Change it so that it prints only `Open the book.` and `Close the book.`. Do not delete the middle line. Turn it into a comment.
hints: Find the line that must not run.
A comment starts with one special character.
Put `#` at the start of the second `print()` line.

print("Open the book.")
print("Draw on the page.")
print("Close the book.")
